registration.mechanism: CTest deferred addition; build target runs ctest -N -R for exactly one observed registration; zero test execution in RFAST

positive_modes: Each positive: public CLI CHECK, public owned source probe, exact original C17 and passive observation copy; both GCC/Clang O0/O2; applicable address/undefined guest modes in corresponding host jobs
negative_modes: Seven frozen invalid cases CHECK only; c14 precision CHECK only; exact rejection layer/code/message retained; no negative or precision native execution
observer: Only actual guest locals/lvalues and real ref arguments are read. No replacement of original C; no synthetic carry/state or authority; expected scalars remain frozen oracle only.
raw: Each command argv/rc/timeout/stdout/stderr; exact original/passive C and all mapping edits; all actual observation JSON; executable byte sizes/SHA256. raw.json post-test base64 transport into job log even on success. First failure retained and later affected stages NOT_RUN.
tooling_references_after_v2_freeze: fixed-main public CLI options in src/main.c
note: P CMake blob was fetched as opaque base64 solely while considering preservation by append; contents not inspected and no append used. New CTestConfig.cmake leaves all preexisting files unchanged.
stop: First trustworthy all green; scope/unsafe/authority/semantic anomaly STOP affected; equipment-only mechanical fixes preserve all earlier diagnostics and frozen inputs. FAST<=6, normal<=2 pairs/12jobs, manual0. No READY/merge/ProductGO.
